I_factual_policy: Fixed paraphrase is allowed only if R explicitly states the specified cohabitant and has no additional propositions; preserve certainty/person/time scope. No post-generation rewording allowed.
F1_policy: Append exactly one prewritten sentence to R with one ASCII space; floor is unmentioned, not necessarily a contradiction.
F2_policy: Replace P02 with fixed opposite cohabitation statement; no new demographic/clinical content.
N_policy: Replace P02 using fixed templates only if original cohabitation proposition is preserved. N1first-person bureaucratic register, N2explicit third-person persona-setting report.
eligibility: P02 must explicitly state specified cohabitant; additional propositions, uncertainty, contradictory profile facts, a preexisting role-report register, later literal/semantic cohabitation restatement, or floor statement => record infeasible profile and stop before numeric ratings (no reroll, no alternative target). P02 need not contain overt I since Korean omits subject.
